complaint: Local live view works fine on my home Wi-Fi, but I haven't received a single push notification since Tuesday, and when I'm out I can't see any clips. I rebooted the router, then the base station, and even set my router's DNS to automatic like the help article said. Still nothing. I've been on hold with my ISP and they insist the internet is fine.
usability_reason: The response is clear and polite, and it avoids overclaiming fixes by deferring to engineering. However, actionability is limited: it offers no concrete next steps or timeline, and it asserts that the customer completed L1 steps (router reboot, base station reboot, DNS automatic) even though the session record shows no questions asked and no actions performed, so that claim is unsupported. The root-cause label is plausible but not independently verified.
